native.label: Native Node
native.executionModel: Fresh host Node.js process for every command sample

commandMetric.mechanism: Spawn node -e and stop when the checksum marker appears on stdout

readyMetric.mechanism: Spawn a fresh host Node.js process and stop at its first stdout response

rawEvidence.selection: seven fresh Node command processes and seven separate fresh readiness processes

runtimes.label: WebVM
runtimes.executionModel: Node.js in WebVM's i386 Linux virtual machine

commandMetric.mechanism: Submit node -e in the logged-in terminal and stop at its checksum marker

readyMetric.mechanism: Navigate a fresh WebVM, log in, and stop when the interactive shell prompt appears

rawEvidence.selection: first Node command from each of seven independent fresh WebVM boots

commandMetric.mechanism: Call container.run(node -e) and stop after checksum stdout plus exit

readyMetric.mechanism: Import, createContainer(), and complete node --version in a fresh headless browser

rawEvidence.selection: first Node command from each of seven independent fresh almostnode containers

runtimes.label: WebContainers
runtimes.executionModel: Node.js process in a StackBlitz WebContainer

commandMetric.mechanism: Spawn a fresh WebContainer Node process and stop after checksum stdout plus exit

readyMetric.mechanism: Call WebContainer.boot() in a fresh headless browser and stop when it resolves

rawEvidence.selection: first Node command from each of seven independent fresh WebContainer boots
